selectionRules.licenceField: observation.sounds[].license_code (the sound's licence, not the observation's)
selectionRules.taxonMatch: observation.taxon.name equals the species name or is a descendant trinomial (species name + ' ' + epithet)
selectionRules.soundsPerObservation: at most one: the first sound in the observation's sounds[] array whose licence is allowed and which is neither hidden nor flagged; if that sound fails a check the observation is rejected (its other sounds are not tried)
selectionRules.userPreference: pass 1 takes only observers not yet used for the species; pass 2 (only if the target is not met) allows a second recording from an already-used observer
selectionRules.ranking: iNaturalist order_by=votes&order=desc for the pool, then re-sorted locally by cached_votes_total descending, observation id ascending
selectionRules.maxBytesNote: 25 MiB = 26214400 bytes; the download is aborted as soon as it exceeds this
selectionRules.decodeCheck: ffmpeg -v error -i <file> -vn -ac 1 -ar 22050 -f f32le pipe:1 must exit 0, print nothing at error level, and yield > 0 samples

sources.name: inaturalist
sources.notes: One request per species (order_by=votes, per_page=200). Files served from static.inaturalist.org/sounds/<soundId>.<ext>.

sources.name: wikimedia_commons
sources.notes: Licence, author and sha1 read from prop=imageinfo extmetadata; downloaded file's sha1 compared against Commons' sha1.
